key.name: virtual-desktop-left
key.summary: Switch to the desktop on the left

key.name: virtual-desktop-right
key.summary: Switch to the desktop on the right

key.name: virtual-desktop-new
key.summary: Create a new desktop and switch to it

key.name: virtual-desktop-close
key.description: Its windows move to the desktop on the left (or on the right, when closing the first desktop).

key.name: persistent-desktops
key.summary: Keep desktops until they are closed
key.description: Like Windows, desktops stay until you close them, even when they are empty. GNOME's dynamic workspaces are turned off while this is on, and back on when it is turned off or the extension is disabled.

key.name: span-all-displays
key.description: Like Windows, desktops span all displays. GNOME's "workspaces on primary display only" is turned off while this is on, and back on when it is turned off or the extension is disabled.

key.name: bounce
key.summary: Bounce at the first and last desktop

key.name: wrap-around
key.summary: Go from the last desktop to the first and back

key.name: switch-indicator
key.summary: What to show while switching desktops
key.description: "name": the desktop's name in the middle of the screen, like Windows 11. "gnome": GNOME's own workspace indicator. "none": nothing.

key.name: indicator-dots
key.summary: Show the desktop's position under its name

key.name: saved-dynamic-workspaces
key.summary: GNOME's dynamic-workspaces value to put back
key.description: 'true' while the extension has turned GNOME's dynamic workspaces off; '' otherwise. Kept here so a crash or logout can't lose it.

key.name: saved-workspaces-only-on-primary
key.summary: GNOME's workspaces-only-on-primary value to put back
key.description: 'true' while the extension has turned it off; '' otherwise.

key.name: saved-num-workspaces
key.summary: GNOME's num-workspaces value to put back (0 = none)

key.name: suspend-shortcuts
key.summary: Shortcuts paused while the settings window records a new one
